question: A chord of length 20 cm makes an angle of 90° at the center of a circle. Find the radius of the circle and the distance of this chord from the center.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For a chord subtending 90° at the center, radius (r) = Chord / √2.

⇒ Radius (r) = 20 / √2 = 10√2 cm.

Distance (d) of the chord from center = Chord / 2 (property of right isosceles triangle altitude).

⇒ Distance (d) = 20 / 2 = 10 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 10√2 cm, 10 cm.**
